onboarding.step1Body: This is your home dashboard. See today's weather, total supplied kg, earnings, and quick actions at a glance.
onboarding.step2Body: Record every fertilizer application, pruning, and plucking round. The smart advisory engine reads these to recommend your next steps.
onboarding.step3Body: Enter your plot details (acreage, bush count, GPS, photos) and divide it into blocks. Admin will approve, then your data auto-fills everywhere.
onboarding.step4Body: Fertilizer cycle due, pruning mixture reminder, weather guard — we send FCM pushes to your phone even when the app is closed.

supplierTips.title: Tips & Guidance
supplierTips.desc: Daily agronomy tips to improve your tea plot's yield, personalized to your registered acreage.
supplierTips.yieldFromFertBody: Based on the fertilizer you've applied so far, you can expect approximately {{kg}} kg of green leaf over the next 30 days.
supplierTips.yieldFromFertDetail: Urea boosts vegetative growth (1 kg Urea ≈ 6 kg leaf); TSP/MOP sustain quality. Actual yield depends on weather, bush age, and plucking cycle.
supplierTips.potentialBody: For your {{acreage}} acres plot ({{region}} region), you could harvest up to {{kg}} kg green leaf per year (~{{monthly}} kg/month). Follow the tips below to reach this potential.
supplierTips.fertGuidanceHint: Recommended fertilizer quantities for your {{acreage}}-acre plot.
supplierTips.tip1Body: Low-country tea can produce about 1,500 kg of green leaf per acre each year when fertilizer and plucking rounds are managed correctly.
supplierTips.tip2Body: For healthy tea bushes, use the recommended annual mix per acre: Urea 50 kg, TSP 25 kg and MOP 25 kg, adjusted by soil-test advice.
supplierTips.tip3Body: Prune tea bushes every three to four years. Correct pruning can improve sustainable yield by about 20%.
supplierTips.tip4Body: Maintain a seven-to-ten-day plucking round to support consistent yield and leaf quality.
supplierTips.tip5Body: Recheck the number of bushes every six months and update the plot when bushes die or new plants are established.
supplierTips.pendingHint: Your plot registration is awaiting approval. Guidance currently uses the acreage in the pending registration.
supplierTips.tipCounter: Tip {{current}} of {{total}}. Use the arrows to browse.
supplierTips.source: Guidance is based on Sri Lankan Tea Research Institute agronomy recommendations.

supplierWeather.title: My Weather
supplierWeather.desc: Live weather forecast for your plot's location. Plan fertilizer application around rain forecasts — rain within 3 days can wash away fertilizer.
supplierWeather.rainAlertBody: ⚠ Avoid applying fertilizer now — rainfall can wash it away before plants absorb it. Wait for a dry window (rain probability < 30%).
